problems.title: Next Greater Element I
problems.notes: monotonic stack + hash map, the pattern's simplest form — pop while the stack top is smaller than the current element

problems.title: Final Prices With a Special Discount in a Shop
problems.notes: the simplest genuinely monotonic-stack-shaped easy problem — next-smaller-or-equal-element in disguise

problems.title: Daily Temperatures
problems.notes: store indices on the stack, not values, so you can compute the distance to the next warmer day

problems.title: Next Greater Element II
problems.notes: circular array: iterate 2n times and mod the index instead of physically doubling the array

problems.title: Online Stock Span
problems.notes: monotonic stack storing (price, span) pairs for an online/streaming variant — collapse spans as you pop

problems.title: Remove K Digits
problems.notes: greedy monotonic stack: pop a bigger digit while removals remain and the next digit is smaller

problems.title: Remove Duplicate Letters
problems.notes: monotonic stack + 'last occurrence index' so you never pop a character you'll still need later in the string

problems.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
problems.notes: THE canonical hard monotonic stack problem; push a sentinel bar of height 0 to flush the stack cleanly at the end

problems.title: Maximal Rectangle
problems.notes: reduce each row to a histogram of consecutive 1s, then reuse Largest Rectangle in Histogram as a subroutine per row
